shortDescription: The SENSEX Index decreased 13 points or 0.02 percent on Tuesday to close at 76944 points.The decline was led by Maruti Suzuki (-4.70%), Nestle India (-4.01%) and Asian Paints (-3.42%).On the upside, the strongest performers were ITC (4.23%), Adani Ports (3.45%) and Bharti Airtel (3.10%).
